title: Tribes influence toward negative one
statement: Let $w,s$ be nonnegative integers and let $i$ be one of the $s$ blocks. For the tribes function on $s$ blocks of $w$ coordinates, the coalitional influence of block $i$ toward $-1$ is $(1-2^{-w})^s$.
